**Clarifying validation scope**

I need to focus on the validation results without changing any tables. It seems the premise config scope doesn't include six documented tables, and now there's explicit evidence that this is an assumption. The final report seems to fail because of this. Can I simply list the validation results with one premise schema name? The agent limits results, so I shouldn't assume full coverage. I want to keep everything concise and avoid creating unnecessary targets.
